acceptance_criteria.description: The registered Harbor and Docker executables, versions, and SHA-256 identities are validated fail closed before execution.
The exact task container and pinned OCI config/rootfs identity are retained and cross-linked into provenance and a content-addressed receipt.
The declared network boundary is actively observed and retained containers and compose networks are removed with an inspectable teardown receipt.
Runner gates and standalone verification reject missing or drifted runtime receipts, and focused plus repository checks pass on the final commit.

objective: Capture fail-closed Harbor executable, Docker task-container, pinned OCI image, network observation, and teardown evidence for a future fresh Terminal-Bench verifier run without changing benchmark-native bytes or relabeling historical results.
title: Bind Harbor Terminal-Bench runtime identity and cleanup evidence
